title: The Wanting Remains
style: Trance, sub-bass drone beneath sparse piano and pads; wide reverb, gentle sidechain, dry up-front lead vocals with stacked harmonies on the hooks; 85–95 BPM, gradual builds into rising dubstep drops; soft intimate female or androgynous bass-baritone vocals, almost spoken in the builds, melodic in the bridges, with long vowel hooks and soft choir-like stacks.
lyrics:
[Intro — soft female melodic]
I still carry the names
I never said out loud.
Some loves stay in the body
long after the world stops looking.

[Build 1 — bass baritone, rap/almost spoken]
Those kinds of crushes
that you bring through decades.
You liked them as a teen;
now you like them still
as we both approach
our mutual middle age.

[Drop 1 — soft intimate female]
Still here.
Still mine.
They never asked
and I never told.
(long open vowels and soft hmmm)

[Bridge 1 — soft female melodic]
There are maps I never drew.
There are doors I left closed
not out of fear,
but out of care
for the life I already built.

[Build 2 — bass baritone, rap/almost spoken]
The transgression
that won’t happen.
The comfort zone
I won’t leave.
Longing is safe,
no energy wasted.
Longing is safe—
no attempt, no fail.

[Drop 2 — soft intimate female]
I kept the wanting quiet
so the rest of me could live.
That was not surrender.
That was strategy.
(long open vowels and layered hmmm)

[Bridge 2 — soft female melodic]
Some of us learn early
how to hold two truths at once:
the one the world can see
and the one that never left the room.

[Build 3 — bass baritone, rap/almost spoken]
Those kinds of crushes
that you bring through decades.
Age ain’t invisible,
but the core’s still there.
But they won’t know
that they ever were,
that they still are.

[Final Drop — soft intimate female]
They won’t know.
We still are.
The core remains.
The wanting remains.
We remain.
(long sustained vowels, soft choir stacks, fading)
